currentHistoryPath.rawCategoryEncoding: categoryRefs indexes categoryIds for the same items array at each observed snapshot
currentHistoryPath.dictionaryRole: provider-scoped category id to display-name resolution only

categorySemantics.streamCategoryChangeHandling: a streamer contributes only at observations where its accepted category identity matches the selected category

aggregationSemantics.viewerMinutes: sum matched observed streamer viewers using the existing bounded History sample-weight rule
aggregationSemantics.dailyPeakViewers: maximum per-snapshot sum of matched selected-category streamer viewers
aggregationSemantics.streamPeakViewers: maximum matched observed viewers for that streamer
aggregationSemantics.dailyObservedStreamCount: unique matched streamer identities observed on that day
aggregationSemantics.topStreamerRanking: selected-category viewer-minutes descending, then existing History tie behavior
aggregationSemantics.biggestRise: derived only from selected-category aggregates when the aligned previous scope is sufficiently covered

sourceBoundary.dailyRollupRejectionReason: daily_rollups do not preserve category membership
sourceBoundary.categoryIntradayRejectionReason: the retained intraday representation is daily-streamer-capped and stores only the dominant category per streamer-hour, so it cannot reconstruct exact per-observation category totals or rankings

coverageContract.observedMeaning: retained source snapshots for the day carry the accepted category contract and required references are resolvable for the observed items used by the result
coverageContract.partialMeaning: some retained observations or item references lack accepted category metadata or dictionary resolution
coverageContract.unavailableMeaning: no retained accepted category observations exist for the requested day, including days outside the raw-retention window
coverageContract.periodStateRule: observed only when all selected completed days are observed; partial when at least one supported day exists with any partial/unavailable day; unavailable when no selected day has supported category observations

comparisonContract.partialCategoryCoverage: withhold precise percentage change and expose partial comparison state

explicitRejections: Do not claim category-aware History coverage from category-blind daily_rollups.
Do not use the 90-day intraday dominant-category representation as exact category History totals or rankings.
Do not interpret days outside retained raw category observations as zero selected-category activity.
Do not back-project a streamer's latest category into historical observations.
Do not silently fall back to unfiltered History when a selected category is unavailable.
nextGate: Implement a Twitch-only hidden History category candidate that reads selected-category results from retained minute snapshots only, exposes day-level category coverage and raw-retention boundaries, preserves the current unfiltered rollup-first path for All categories, and passes local/CI plus deployed hidden validation before any public-cutover decision.
